newsitem.title: POLAND: Agros Q1 group net falls to PLN 8 mln.
newsitem.headline: Agros Q1 group net falls to PLN 8 mln.

text.p: Polish food trading and production firm Agros Holding SA recorded a first quarter group net profit of about eight million zlotys on sales of 304.2 million, the company's deputy president said on Tuesday.
"In the first quarter of 1997 our consolidated sales amounted to 304.2 million zlotys and the net profit was about eight million," Marek Gucik told a news conference.
In the first quarter of 1996 Agros reported a consolidated net of 10.8 million zlotys on sales of 279 million zlotys.
Agros has yet to publish its full consolidated results for the first quarter.

Gucik said that even though first quarter sales amounted to 20 percent of the 1997 plan and net profit was lower than expected, Agros maintained its 1997 forecast of consolidated net profit of 80 million zlotys on 1.5 billion zlotys in sales.
"We uphold our forecast and our production results in the first quarter and new investments justify the forecast," Gucik said.

He said the net result was lowered by higher than expected financial costs, mainly of bank credits for new acquisitions which Agros had originally planned to finance from proceeds from its recent new share issue of about 170 million zlotys.
But he said further planned acquisitions should help boost the group's results later in the year and meet its targets.
